title: Socotada Beerta Verdant
intro: Waagii hore, laba qof ayaa daryeeli jiray dhulalka deriska la ah. Waddooyinkoodu way isku xidhnaayeen, haddana qalbiyadoodu waxay u horseeday meelo aad u kala duwan. Mid baa ku socday waddada toosan, halka kan kalena uu ku dhex milmay mugdiga beenta. Ma furi kartaa sirta labadan ilaaliye ee goosashada?
clues: Waxaan haystay dalagyo badan, goosasho raaxo leh oo indhaha dadka daawanaya soo jiidatay.
Deriskaygu wuxuu lahaa deeq ka badan tan aan haystay, haddana waxaan jeclaa qaybtooda in ka badan tayda.
Waxaan soo jeediyay inaan gebi ahaanba burburinno dalagyadooda, si aan u xoojinno wax kasta oo aan gacanta ku hayo.
Waxaan sidoo kale burburiyay goosashadaydii, anigoo wax walba ku burburiyay shirqoolkayga nacasnimada ah.
Waxaan istaagay anigoo aan waxba haysan iyadoo dalaggaygu engegay, hantidayduna ay isu beddeshay ciid habeen keliya gudaheed.
Wax qayb ah kuma lahayn Aakhiro, hoygaygii ugu dambeeyayna wuxuu noqday god dab ah oo ololaya.

identity.label: Kumaan ahay?
options: Ninkii beeniyay sarakicidda iyo xukunka
Taliyihii dulmiyay beeralayda xaqa ah
Mulkiilaha dhulka ee hodanka ah oo aan mahadnaq lahayn
Beeralaydii damacday dhulka deriskooda
Lamaanaha khaa'inka ah ee halaagga maleegay

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Imtixaanka helitaanka muujinta rabbaaniga ah
Caqabadda maalka iyo dulqaadka
Jirrabaadda lagu burburinayo nolosha qofka xaqa ah
Amarka ah in si caddaalad ah loo qaybiyo dhaxalka
Halganka ka dhanka ah dulmiga kaligii-taliye
trial.answer: Jirrabaadda lagu burburinayo nolosha qofka xaqa ah

location.label: Qaybta Muhiimka ah
options: Beeraha cagaaran ee jannada
Laba beerood oo dalagyo ah oo deris la ah
Buurihii burburka arkay
Macbadka barakeysan ee Makkah
Webiga dhul barakeysan
location.answer: Laba beerood oo dalagyo ah oo deris la ah

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Janno weligeed ah oo ah abaal-marin xaqnimo
Burbur dhammaystiran oo labada goosasho ah noloshan
Masaafuris iyo warwareeg ilaa dhimasho
Barwaaqo ku meel gaar ah oo ay ku xigto dab waara
Soo celin mucjiso ah iyo abaalmarin labanlaab ah
outcome.answer: Burbur dhammaystiran oo labada goosasho ah noloshan

verse: Then they approached one another, blaming each other. (68:30)
